capabilities: toggle cypher mode on and off from the ribbon
convert selected text to cipher symbols via command
transform text in real time as you type
handle spaces and backspaces while cyphered
choose between different cypher icon styles
disambiguation: Not an encryption or security tool; it is a visual symbol substitution that reverts to plain text with one toggle.
extras: The README's example sections show only placeholder code blocks, so the visual result is not demonstrated in text.
motivation: The README frames it as making notes "enigmatic, fun, and visually distinct", i.e. adding mystery and visual intrigue rather than serving a productivity purpose.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to display note text as symbols or an obscure script for fun or visual separation from plain reading.
summary: Cypher mode that visually replaces typed text with icon-based cipher symbols, toggled on or off without changing the underlying text.
